name: ProPresenter 7
author: Control It Team
subtitle: Live Presentation & Lyrics Control
descriptionText: Control slides, stage displays, media playlists, clear layers, and triggers on Renewed Vision ProPresenter 7 via direct API / WebSocket.

setupFields.label: ProPresenter Host / IP
setupFields.helpText: Enter IP address of computer running ProPresenter 7.

setupFields.label: Network Port
setupFields.helpText: Default ProPresenter API port is 1025 or 50001.

actions.title: ProPresenter: Next Slide
actions.subtitle: Advance presentation
actions.descriptionText: Triggers the next slide in the active presentation or playlist.

actions.title: ProPresenter: Previous Slide
actions.subtitle: Go back one slide
actions.descriptionText: Triggers the previous slide in the active presentation.

actions.title: ProPresenter: Clear All
actions.subtitle: Clear presentation & props
actions.descriptionText: Instantly clears all active presentation, media, and announcement layers.
